1.1: Maaser sheni, en mochrin oto, veen memashkenin oto, veen machalifin oto, velo shoklin kennegdo. velo yomar adam lachavero birushalayim, helach yayin veten li shamen. vechen shear kol happerot. aval notnin ze laze mattenat chinnam:
1.2: Masar behema, en mochrin oto tamim chay, velo vaal mum chay veshachut, veen mekaddeshin bo haishsha. habbechor mochrin oto tamim chay, uvaal mum chay veshachut, umekaddeshin bo haishsha. en mechallelin maaser sheni al asimon, velo al hammatbea sheeno yotze, velo al hammaot sheenan birshuto:
1.3: Hallokeach behema lezivche shelamim, o chayya livsar taava, yatza haor lechullin, af al pi shehaor merubbe al habbasar. kadde yayin setumot, mekom sheddarkan limkor setumot, yatza kankan lechullin. haegozim vehashshekedim, yatzu kelippehem lechullin. hattemed, ad shello hechmitz, eno nilkach bechesef maaser. umishshehechmitz, nilkach bechesef maaser:
1.4: Hallokeach chayya lezivche shelamim, behema livsar taava, lo yatza haor lechullin. kadde yayin petuchot o setumot, mekom sheddarkan limmacher petuchot, lo yatza kankan lechullin. salle zetim vesalle anavim im hakkeli, lo yatzu deme hakkeli lechullin:
1.5: Hallokeach mayim, umelach, uferot hamechubbarim lakkarka, o ferot sheenan yecholin lehaggia lirushalayim, lo kana maaser. hallokeach perot, shogeg, yachzeru damim limkoman. mezid, yoolu veyeachlu vammakom. veim en mikdash, yerakkevu:
1.6: Hallokeach behema, shogeg, yachzeru dameha limkoman. mezid, toole veteachel bammakom. veim en mikdash, tikkaver al yede orah:
1.7: En lokchin avadim ushefachot vekarkaot uvehema temea middeme maaser sheni. veim lakach, yochal kenegdan. en meviin kinne zavim, vekinne zavot, vekinne yoldot, chattaot, vaashamot, middeme maaser sheni. veim hevi, yochal kenegdam. ze hakkelal, kol shehu chutz laachila velishtiyya ulesicha middeme maaser sheni, yochal kenegdo:

2.1: Maaser sheni, nittan laachila velishtiyya ulesicha, leechol davar sheddarko leechol, lasuch davar sheddarko lasuch. lo yasuch yayin vechometz, aval sach hu et hashshemen. en mefattemin shemen shel maaser sheni, veen lokchin bidme maaser sheni shemen mefuttam, aval mefattem hu et hayyayin. nafal letocho devash utevalin vehishbicho, hashshevach lefi cheshbon. dagim shennitbashshelu im hakkaflotot shel maaser sheni vehishbichu, hashshevach lefi cheshbon. issa shel maaser sheni sheafaah vehishbiach, hashshevach lashsheni. ze hakkelal, kol sheshshivcho nikkar, hashshevach lefi hacheshbon. vechol sheen shivcho nikkar, hashshevach lashsheni:
2.2: Rabbi shimon omer, en sachin shemen shel maaser sheni birushalayim. vachachamim mattirin. amru lo lerabbi shimon, im hekel bitruma chamura, lo nakel bemaaser sheni hakkal. amar lahem, ma, lo, im hekel bitruma hachamura mekom shehekel becharshinim uvetiltan, nakel bemaaser sheni hakkal mekom shello hekel becharshinim uvetiltan:
2.3: Tiltan shel maaser sheni, teachel tzimchonim. veshel teruma, bet shammay omrim, kol maaseha betohora, chutz mechafifatah. uvet hillel omrim, kol maaseha vetuma, chutz mishsheriyyatah:
2.4: Karshine maaser sheni, yeachlu tzimchonim, venichnasin lirushalayim veyotzin. nitmeu, rabbi tarfon omer, yitchalleku leissot, vachachamim omrim, yippadu. veshel teruma, bet shammay omrim, shorin veshafin betohora, umaachilin betuma. uvet hillel omrim, shorin betohora, veshafin umaachilin betuma. shammay omer, yeachlu tzarid. rabbi akiva omer, kol maasehen betuma:
2.5: Meot chullin umeot maaser sheni shennitpazzeru, ma shellikket, likket lemaaser sheni, ad sheyyashlim, vehashshear chullin. im balal vechafan, lefi cheshbon. ze hakkelal, hammitlakketim, lemaaser sheni. vehannivlalim, lefi cheshbon:
2.6: Sela shel maaser sheni veshel chullin shennitarvu, mevi vesela maot veomer, sela shel maaser sheni, bechol makom shehi, mechullelet al hammaot haellu, uvorer et hayyafa shebbah, umechallelan aleha, mippene sheamru, mechallelin kesef al nechoshet middochak, velo sheyyitkayyem ken, ella chozer umechallelam al hakkasef:
2.7: Bet shammay omrim, lo yaase adam et selaav dinre zahav, uvet hillel mattirin. amar rabbi akiva, ani asiti lerabban gamliel ulerabbi yehoshua et kaspan dinre zahav:
2.8: Happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni, bet shammay omrim, kol hassela maot. uvet hillel omrim, shekel kesef veshekel maot. rabbi meir omer, en mechallelin kesef uferot al hakkesef, vachachamim mattirim:
2.9: Happoret sela shel maaser sheni birushalayim, bet shammay omrim, kol hassela maot. uvet hillel omrim, shekel kesef veshekel maot. haddanin lifne chachamim omrim, bishlosha dinare kesef vedinar maot. rabbi akiva omer, shelosha dinarin kesef, ureviit maot. rabbi tarfon omer, arbaa aspere chesef. shammay omer, yannichenna vachanut veyochal kenegdah:
2.10: Mi shehayu miktzat banav temein umiktzatan tehorim, manniach et hassela veomer, ma shehattehorim shotim, sela zo mechullelet alav. nimtzeu tehorim utemeim shotin mikkad echad:

3.1: Lo yomar adam lachavero, haal et happerot haellu lirushalayim lechallek, ella omer lo, haalem shennochlem venishtem birushalayim. aval notnim ze laze mattenat chinnam:
3.2: En lokchin teruma bechesef maaser sheni, mippene shehu memaet baachilato, verabbi shimon mattir. amar lahem rabbi shimon, ma im hekel bezivche shelamim, shehu mevian lide figgul venotar vetame, lo nakel batteruma. amru lo, ma im hekel bezivche shelamim, shehen muttarim lezarim, nakel batteruma, shehi asura lezarim:
3.3: Mi shehayu lo maot birushalayim vetzarich lo, velachavero ferot, omer lachavero, hare hammaot haellu mechullalin al perotecha. nimtza ze ochel perotav betohora, vehalla ose tzarko bimotav. velo yomar ken leam haaretz, ella vidmay:
3.4: Perot birushalayim umaot bammedina, omer, hare hammaot hahem mechullalin al perot haellu. maot birushalayim uferot bammedina, omer hare hammaot haellu mechullalin al perot hahem, uvilvad sheyyoolu happerot veyeachlu virushalayim:
3.5: Maot nichnasot lirushalayim veyotzot, uferot nichnasin veenan yotzin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af happerot nichnasin veyotzin:
3.6: Perot shennigmera melachtan veavru vetoch yerushalayim, yachazor maaser sheni shellahen veyeachel birushalayim. veshello nigmera melachtan, salle anavim laggat vesalle teenim lammuktze, bet shammay omrim, yachazor maaser sheni shellahem veyeachel birushalayim. uvet hillel omrim, yippade veyeachel bechol makom. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose, lo nechleku vet shammay uvet hillel al perot shello nigmera melachtan, sheyyippade maaser sheni shellahem veyeachel bechol makom. veal ma nechleku, al perot shennigmera melachtan, shebbet shammay omrim, yachazor maaser sheni shellahem veyeachel birushalayim. uvet hillel omrim, yippade veyeachel bechol makom. vehaddemay, nichnas veyotze venifde:
3.7: Ilan shehu omed bifnim venote lachutz, o omed bachutz venote lifnim, mikkeneged hachoma velifnim, kelifnim. mikkeneged hachoma velachutz, kelachutz. batte habbaddim sheppitchehen lifnim vachalalan lachutz, o sheppitchehen lachutz vachalalan lifnim, bet shammay omrim, hakkol kelifnim. uvet hillel omrim, mikkeneged hachoma velifnim, kelifnim. mikkeneged hachoma velachutz, kelachutz:
3.8: Halleshachot, benuyot bakkodesh ufetuchot lachol, tochan chol vegaggotehen kodesh. benuyot bachol ufetuchot lakkodesh, tochan kodesh vegaggotehen chol. benuyot bakkodesh uvachol ufetuchot lakkodesh velachol, tochan vegaggotehen mikkeneged hakkodesh velakkodesh, kodesh, mikkeneged hachol velachol, chol:
3.9: Maaser sheni shennichnas lirushalayim venitma, ben shennitma veav hattuma, ben shennitma bivlad hattuma, ben bifnim ben bachutz, bet shammay omrim, yippade veyeachel hakkol bifnim, chutz mishshennitma beav hattuma bachutz. uvet hillel omrim, hakkol yippade veyeachel bachutz, chutz mishshennitma bivlad hattuma bifnim:
3.10: Hallakuach bechesef maaser sheni shennitma, yippade. rabbi yehuda omer, yikkaver. amru lo lerabbi yehuda, uma im maaser sheni atzmo shennitma, hare hu nifde, hallakuach bechesef maaser sheni shennitma, eno din sheyyippade. amar lahem, lo, im amartem bemaaser sheni atzmo, shekken hu nifde vetahor berichuk makom, tomru velakuach bechesef maaser, sheeno nifde vetahor berichuk makom:
3.11: Tzevi shellekacho bechesef maaser, vamet, yikkaver al yede oro. rabbi shimon omer, yippade. lekacho chay ushechato venitma, yippade. rabbi yose omer, yikkaver. lekacho shachut venitma, hare hu cheferot:
3.12: Hammashil kankannin lemaaser sheni, af al pi sheggafan, lo kana maaser. zalaf letochan setam, ad shello gafan, lo kana maaser. mishsheggafan, kana maaser. ad shello gafan, olot beechad umea, umishsheggafan, mekaddeshot bechol shehen. ad shello gafan, torem meachat al hakkol, umishsheggafan, torem mikkol achat veechat:
3.13: Bet shammay omrim, mefatteach umeare laggat. uvet hillel omrim, mefatteach veeno tzarich learot. bamme devarim amurim, bemakom sheddarkan limkor setumot. aval bemakom sheddarkan limkor petuchot, lo yatza kankan lechullin. aval im ratza lehachemir al atzmo limkor bemidda, yatza kankan lechullin. rabbi shimon omer, af haomer lachavero, chavit zo ani mocher lecha chutz mikkankannim, yatza kankan lechullin:

4.1: Hammolich perot maaser sheni mimmekom hayyoker limkom hazzol, o mimmekom hazzol limkom hayyoker, podehu cheshaar mekomo. hammevi ferot min haggoren lair, vechadde yayin min haggat lair, hashshevach lashsheni vitziot mibbeto:
4.2: Podin maaser sheni beshaar hazzol, kemot shehachenvani lokeach, lo chemot shehu mocher. kemot shehashshulchani foret, velo chemot shehu metzaref. veen podin maaser sheni achsara. et sheddamav yeduim, yippade al pi ed echad. veet sheen damav yeduim, yippade al pi shelosha, kegon hayyayin shekkaram uferot shehirkivu umaot shehecheliu:
4.3: Baal habbayit omer besela veacher omer besela, baal habbayit kodem, mippene shehu mosif chomesh. baal habbayit omer besela veacher omer besela veissar, et shel sela veissar kodem, mippene shehu mosif al hakkeren. happode maaser sheni shello, mosif alav chamishshit, ben shehu shello uven shennittan lo bemattana:
4.4: Maarimin al maaser sheni. ketzad, omer adam livno ulevitto haggedolim, leavdo uleshifchato haivrim, helach maot ellu ufede lach maaser sheni ze. aval lo yomar ken livno ulevitto hakketannim, leavdo uleshifchato hakkenaanim, mippene sheyyadan keyado:
4.5: Haya omed baggoren veen beyado maot, omer lachavero, hare happerot haellu netunim lach bemattana. chozer veomer, hare ellu mechullalin al maot shebbabbayit:
4.6: Mashach mimmennu maaser besela, velo hispik lifdoto ad sheamad bishtayim, noten lo sela, umistakker besela, umaaser sheni shello. mashach mimmennu maaser bishtayim, velo hispik lifdoto ad sheamad besela, noten lo sela mechullin vesela shel maaser sheni shello. im haya am haaretz, noten lo middemay:
4.7: Happode maaser sheni velo kara shem, rabbi yose omer, dayyo. rabbi yehuda omer, tzarich lefaresh. haya medabber im haishsha al iske gittah vekiddusheha, venatan lah gittah vekiddusheha velo feresh, rabbi yose omer, dayyo. rabbi yehuda omer, tzarich lefaresh:
4.8: Hammanniach issar veachal alav chetzyo, vehalach lemakom acher vahare hu yotze befundeyon, ochel alav od issar. hammanniach pundeyon veachal alav chetzyo, vehalach lemakom acher vahare hu yotze beissar, ochel alav od pelag. hammanniach issar shel maaser sheni, ochel alav achad asar beissar veechad mimmea beissar. bet shammay omrim, hakkol asara. uvet hillel omrim, bavvadday achad asar, uvaddemay asara:
4.9: Kol hammaot hannimtzaim, hare ellu chullin, afillu dinar zahav im hakkesef veim hammaot. matza vetochan cheres vechatuv alav maaser, hare ze maaser:
4.10: Hammotze cheli vechatuv alav karban, rabbi yehuda omer, im haya shel cheres, hu chullin uma shebbetocho karban. veim haya shel mattechet, hu karban uma shebbetocho chullin. amru lo, en derech bene adam lihyot konsin chullin lekarban:
4.11: Hammotze cheli vechatuv alav kuf, karban. 40, maaser. 4, demay. 9, tevel. 400, teruma, shebbishat sakkana hayu chotvin 400 tachat teruma. rabbi yose omer, kullam shemot bene adam hem. amar rabbi yose, afillu matza chavit vehi melea ferot vechatuv aleha teruma, hare ellu chullin, sheani omer eshtakad hayta melea ferot teruma, ufinnah:
4.12: Haomer livno, maaser sheni bezavit zo, umatza vezavit acheret, hare ellu chullin. haya sham mane umatza matayim, hashshear chullin. matayim umatza mane, hakkol maaser:

5.1: Kerem revai, metzayyenin oto bekozzot adama, veshel arla becharsit, veshel kevarot besid, umemache veshofech. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, bamme devarim amurim, bashsheviit. vehatztzenuim mannichin et hammaot veomrim, kol hannilkat mizze, yehe mechullal al hammaot haellu:
5.2: Kerem revai haya ole lirushalayim mahalach yom echad lechol tzad. veezo hi techumah, elat min haddarom veakrabbat min hatztzafon, lod min hammaarav vehayyarden min hammizrach. umishsherabbu happerot, hitkinu sheyyehe nifde samuch lachoma. utenay haya haddavar, sheematay sheyyirtzu, yachazor haddavar lichmot shehaya. rabbi yose omer, mishshecharav bet hammikdash, haya hattenay hazze. utenay haya, ematay sheyyibbane bet hammikdash, yachazor haddavar lichmot shehaya:
5.3: Kerem revai, bet shammay omrim, en lo chomesh veen lo viur. uvet hillel omrim, yesh lo. bet shammay omrim, yesh lo feret veyesh lo ollot, vehaaniyyim podin leatzman. uvet hillel omrim, kullo laggat:
5.4: Ketzad podin neta revai, manniach et hassal al pi shelosha, veomer, kamma adam rotze lifdot lo vesela al menat lehotzi yetziot mibbeto. umanniach et hammaot, veomer, kol hannilkat mizze, mechullal al hammaot haellu bechach vechach sallim besala:
5.5: Uvashsheviit, podehu veshavyo. veim haya hakkol mufkar, en lo ella sechar lekita. happode neta revai shello, mosif alav chamishshito, ben shehu shello uven shennittan lo bemattana:
5.6: Erev yom tov harishon shel pesach shel reviit veshel sheviit, haya viur. ketzad haya viur, notnin teruma uterumat maaser labbealim, umaaser rishon livalav, umaasar ani livalav. umaaser sheni vehabbikkurim mitbaarim bechol makom. rabbi shimon omer, habbikkurim nittanin lakkohanim katteruma. hattavshil, bet shammay omrim, tzarich levaer. uvet hillel omrim, hare hu kimvoar:
5.7: Mi shehayu lo ferot bazzeman hazze vehiggia sheat habbiur, bet shammay omrim, tzarich lechallelan al hakkesef. uvet hillel omrim, echad shehen kesef veechad shehen perot:
5.8: Amar rabbi yehuda, barishona hayu sholchin etzel baale vattim shebbammedinot, maharu vehatekinu et perotechem ad shello taggia sheat habbiur. ad shebba rabbi akiva velimmed, shekkol happerot shello vau leonat hammaasrot, peturim min habbiur:
5.9: Mi shehayu ferotav rechokim mimmennu, tzarich likro lahem shem. maase verabban gamliel vehazzekenim shehayu vain bisfina, amar rabban gamliel, issur sheani atid lamod, natun lihoshua, umekomo muskar lo. issur acher sheani atid lamod, natun laakiva ven yosef sheyyizke vo laaniyyim, umekomo muskar lo. amar rabbi yehoshua, issur sheani atid lamod natun leelazar ben azarya, umekomo muskar lo. venitkabbelu ze mizze sachar:
5.10: Bammincha veyom tov haacharon hayu mitvaddin. ketzad haya havvidduy, biarti hakkodesh min habbayit (Devarim 26), ze maaser sheni veneta revai. netattiv lallevi, ze masar levi. vegam netattiv, zo teruma uterumat maaser. lagger layyatom velaalmana, ze maasar ani, halleket vehashshichcha vehappea, af al pi sheenan meakkevin et havvidduy. min habbayit, zo challa:
5.11: Kechol mitzvatcha asher tzivvitani (sham), ha im hikdim maaser sheni larishon, eno yachol lehitvaddot. lo avarti mimmitzvotecha, lo hifrashti mimmin al sheeno mino, velo min hattalush al hamechubbar, velo min hamechubbar al hattalush, velo min hechadash al hayyashan, velo min hayyashan al hechadash. velo shachachti, lo shachachti millevarechcha umillehazkir shimcha alav:
5.12: Lo achalti veoni mimmennu (sham), ha im achalo vaanina eno yachol lehitvaddot. velo viarti mimmennu betame, ha im hifrisho vetuma eno yachol lehitvaddot. velo natatti mimmennu lemet, lo lakachti mimmennu aron vetachrichim lemet, velo netattiv leonnim acherim. shamati vekol Adonai elohay, havetiv levet habbechira. asiti kechol asher tzivvitani, samachti vesimmachti vo:
5.13: Hashekifa mimmeon kadshecha min hashshamayim (Devarim 26, 15), asinu ma sheggazarta alenu, af atta ase ma shehivtachtanu, hashekifa mimmeon kadshecha min hashshamayim uvarech et ammecha et yisrael bevanim uvevanot. veet haadama asher natatta lanu, betal uvematar uvevaldot behema. kaasher nishbata laavotenu eretz zavat chalav udevash, kede shettitten taam bapperot:
5.14: Mikkan amru, yisrael umamzerim mitvaddim, aval lo gerim velo avadim meshuchrarim, sheen lahem chelek baaretz. rabbi meir omer, af lo chohanim uleviyyim, shello natlu chelek baaretz. rabbi yose omer, yesh lahem are migrash:
5.15: Yochanan kohen gadol heevir hodayot hammaaser. af hu bittel et hameorrim, veet hannokfim. vead yamav haya fattish makke virushalayim, uveyamav en adam tzarich lishol al haddemay:
